scripts.dev:desktop: cd crates/dd-desktop/frontend && bun install && TAURI_APP_PATH=../backend TAURI_FRONTEND_PATH=. bunx tauri dev
scripts.build:desktop: cd crates/dd-desktop/frontend && bun install && TAURI_APP_PATH=../backend TAURI_FRONTEND_PATH=. bunx tauri build && cd ../../.. && cp target/release/dd-desktop.exe dist/dd-desktop.exe
